LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Ontario

Most visitors need an Outdoors Card and a fishing licence. Foreign visitors aged 65 and older still need a licence; a one-day licence does not require an Outdoors Card.

  • 1 calendar day$24.86 CAD
  • 8 consecutive days$54.38 CAD
  • 8 consecutive days$31.52 CAD
  • 1 calendar year$83.19 CAD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Lac Seul prohibits possession of live angling-caught fish other than baitfish.
  • Release all muskellunge.
  • Walleye and sauger combined: Sport limit four, Conservation two; none between 46–53 cm and at most one over 53 cm.
  • Check connected-water sanctuaries official regulations ↗

Full Ontario licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
